integrity: The proof uses an explicit semigroup model, standard contraction-semigroup unitary dilation and a weakly null frequency construction; independent verification not performed.
scientific_limitations: Classical H^2 only and the displayed affine semigroup; no assertion for other H^p spaces, general semiflows or full spectral classification. Historical priority remains qualified by inaccessible older full text.
title: Complete essential Fourier calculus for an affine Hardy composition semigroup
